description: Passenger rail usage is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Office of Rail and Road. Shows passenger rail usage within Great Britain. This shows the number of journeys undertaken, the KM travelled and revenue made by train operators. Source agency: Office of Rail and Road Designation: National Statistics Language: English Alternative title: Rail usage. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Office of Rail and Road. It offers 12 resource(s) in ODS. The portal shows 2020-10-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
